name: confluence-sync
description: Git-like pull/push/status sync between local Markdown notes (Obsidian vault) and Confluence Cloud pages, split into four skills by risk: status (read-only), link, pull, push. One link command for pages and folders that accepts a pasted URL, title search, optimistic-locking conflict detection. Rich content round-trips: callouts as panels, decisions and expands, tasks with dates, status lozenges, images, page links, smart links, code languages, Mermaid diagrams drawn by the Confluence app, PlantUML, mentions; anything else is kept untouched. Note frontmatter mirroring and folder name sync. Also creates pages, folders and whole project trees from a spec.
